summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Analysis and Information Management Training Course. Learn to analyze data effectively and manage information efficiently.
lede: Data analysis and information management help professionals turn operational records into reliable, decision-ready reporting. Designed for people who clean, analyze, report, or govern workplace data, the course covers profiling and cleaning datasets, interpreting descriptive statistics and dashboards, and organizing data definitions and metadata. Learners also practice creating quality checks and presenting evidence-backed insights for recurring management reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, analyze, clean, report, or govern data in day-to-day operations.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of spreadsheets, basic numeracy, and familiarity with everyday reporting or data handling tasks. You should be comfortable opening, filtering, and sorting tabular data in Microsoft Excel or a comparable spreadsheet tool. Coding is not required for completion, although prior exposure to SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or Python for analytics will help you apply the course outputs more quickly. Advanced concepts such as governance design and information architecture are taught at an operational application level, not as technical engineering.
